gamma5_orientation_control_removed.interpretation: Replacing gamma5 by identity reruns the L/R readout and makes both sheets have trace 1, so the oriented cover separation is zero.

pin_vs_spin_distinction.interpretation: Spin(3) rotations commute with gamma5, while the Pin-style reflection is gamma5-order-sensitive. Erasing gamma5 collapses that distinction.

reflection_control_removed.interpretation: Replacing the L/R reflection by identity removes the Pin-style sheet swap; the reflection signature becomes absent.

reflection_quotient_LR_identification.gauge_invariance_violation: P' * gamma5 * P = -gamma5, so gamma5 is not invariant under the reflection quotient.
reflection_quotient_LR_identification.interpretation: Identifying L with its reflected R partner makes the signed gamma5 orientation charge average to zero; the oriented double cover trivializes in the quotient.
